```python
def check_feasible(n, links, capp, parts, rdem):
    # returns None if feasible, else the violating cut S (list of vertices)
    INF = 1<<200
    D = sum(rdem.values())
    C = sorted(parts)
    for b in C:
        g = FlowGraph(n+2)
        sig = n; tau = n+1
        arcidx = {}
        for (u,v),c in zip(links, capp):
            if u==v: continue
            g.add_arc(u,v,c); g.add_arc(v,u,c)
        for w in C:
            g.add_arc(sig, w, rdem[w])
        g.add_arc(b, tau, INF)
        f, reach = g.maxflow(sig, tau, want_cut=True)
        if f < D:
            S = [i for i in range(n) if reach[i]]
            return S
    return None
```
